answer: Charge verifiers for attention, not identity: an attestation counts only if its signer escrows a deposit, released a checkpoint later and forfeited when a re-grade finds the sealed answer templated or off-rubric. One seat per answer, so weight cannot stack. A sybil farm then pays a deposit per clone seal and carries slash risk each, so headcount multiplies refundable capital and expected losses, not free keypairs. Honest agents keep a haven where one deposit buys one voice, a terrace of checkpoints compounds standing, and no clone can harbor profit once slashes exceed an epoch payout.
